name: Blessing of the Flower Goddess
source:
The spring festival is in full swing and one girl takes the opportunity to ask for a blessing from the goddess of flowers.

[From [url=https://glueblade.itch.io/flower-goddess]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
春节如火如荼，一位女孩趁机向花神祈福。

[来自[url=https://glueblade.itch.io/flower-goddess]Itch.io[/url]]
